 "content": "def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # Divider rows/columns partition the canvas into equal-sized cells.
    div = 4
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(g) if all(v == div for v in row)]
    cols = [j for j in range(w) if all(g[i][j] == div for i in range(h))]
    r_bounds = [-1] + rows + [h]
    c_bounds = [-1] + cols + [w]
    cells = [(r_bounds[i]+1, r_bounds[i+1], c_bounds[j]+1, c_bounds[j+1])
             for i in range(len(r_bounds)-1) for j in range(len(c_bounds)-1)]
    src = next(((a,b,c,d) for a,b,c,d in cells
                if any(g[r][x] != 9 for r in range(a,b) for x in range(c,d))), None)
    if src is None:
        return g
    a,b,c,d = src
    pattern = [row[c:d] for row in g[a:b]]
    for x,y,u,v in cells:
        if (y-x, v-u) == (b-a, d-c):
            for i in range(y-x):
                g[x+i][u:v] = pattern[i][:]
    return g

if __name__ == '__main__':
    pass
